column2: 012.M42. Khorne, Nurgle, Tzeentch and Slaanesh have wagered a shrine world in the Great Game. Four traitor legions breach Aeternum Sanctus — and each wants the prize for its own god alone. The Ultramarines, Blood Angels and Salamanders swear to defend it together

column2: 014.M42. The Tau Empire raised the colony of Dal'ryn upon golden dunes — unaware that a tomb of the Sautekh Dynasty slept there. Imotekh awakens, furious. And in the sky, a Rok full of Orks has already smelled the biggest brawl in the sector

column2: 015.M42. The forge world of Thaurus Prime guards an intact STC archive. The Death Guard want to infect the forges, the Thousand Sons want the archive for Magnus and the Drukhari want millions of slaves. The Mechanicus resists, and the Imperium answers: Sisters of Battle, Custodians and Grey Knights
column3: 015.M42. El mundo forja Thaurus Prime guarda un archivo STC intacto. El Mechanicus resiste, y el Imperio responde: Hermanas de Batalla, Custodios y Caballeros Grises

column2: 813.M41. Cardinal Xaphan proclaimed Vraks free of the Emperor and handed the arsenal to Chaos. The Death Korps of Krieg dig trenches around the Citadel: the siege will last for years.
